prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one production sprite atlas for the MicroCol colonial town UI, matching the supplied selected UI reference's warm hand-inked building illustrations. Reference is style only, NOT an edit target. Transparent background, square canvas, EXACT uniform 4 columns x 4 rows. Each cell contains one separate freestanding building vignette, no overlap, generous transparent margin 12% on all sides; all ground baselines at 80% of each cell. No labels, no letters, no UI, no frames, no people. Crisp charcoal ink outlines, ivory plaster, honey timber, slate gray and muted terracotta roofs, small olive shrubs. Front three-quarter view with low perspective; readable silhouettes at 150px.
These are the BASIC / first-level buildings, modest and small, in this exact row-major order:
row1: Dutch stepped-gable town hall with small flag; small simple chapel; modest one-room schoolhouse; small timber print workshop with paper sheets by door.
row2: open carpenters timber stand with lumber; small blacksmith house with glowing forge; small armory with muskets stacked outside; wooden stockade with gateway and small watch platform.
row3: small tobacco drying/tobacconist house with hanging tobacco leaves; small thatched weaver cottage with loom; small rum distiller cottage with copper still and barrel; fur trader log cabin with hanging animal pelts.
row4: modest open basic warehouse with crates; small wooden stable with horse visible; simple timber dock and one mooring post with tiny teal water accent; larger plaster customs house with flag and customs crates.
Keep everything entirely within its cell. Real alpha transparency. Match the selected reference's charming simple game illustration, not photorealism.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite atlas, matching supplied MicroCol UI reference warm hand-drawn ink illustration style. Transparent background. EXACT 4x4 equal cells square canvas. CRITICAL: leave completely empty transparent gutters at x=25%,50%,75% and y=25%,50%,75%; each building entirely inside central 76% width and 76% height of its cell. No text or interface. Every item isolated, no shared bushes or ground. Charcoal ink outline, ivory plaster, terracotta or slate roofs, honey timber, olive shrubs. Small readable game illustrations, front three-quarter low perspective.
Sixteen upgraded colonial buildings, row-major:
1 ornate stepped-gable town hall; 2 medium church with long nave and tower; 3 college with two attached wings; 4 newspaper printing works, two-story brick building with tall chimney and stacks of papers.
5 lumber mill with timber yard and water wheel; 6 blacksmith shop with two forges and stone chimney; 7 stone magazine with fortified door, cannon and weapon racks; 8 stone fort, two squat towers, stone wall and central gateway.
9 tobacconist shop, two-story house and hanging tobacco racks; 10 weavers shop, plaster workshop with large visible loom; 11 rum distillery, larger red brick workshop with two copper stills; 12 fur trading post, two wooden buildings, hanging furs.
13 closed stone warehouse with large arch and crates; 14 large stables, two connected barns, horses and fence; 15 drydock with wooden scaffolding around an unfinished small ship hull; 16 customs house with flag and crate stacks.
DO NOT DRAW PEOPLE, numbers, captions, frames, shadows outside cells, or an opaque background. Clean alpha. Keep the exact 4x4 cell grid and empty gutters.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a transparent sprite atlas for MicroCol, in the hand-inked style of reference image. ONE square sheet with EXACT 4 columns and 4 rows, sixteen separate colonial buildings. Every sprite isolated with ample clear transparent gutters, no text, no labels, no people, no interface. Each building must fit inside its own equal-sized cell. Charcoal outlines, warm ivory plaster, ochre timber, slate and muted terracotta roofs, small olive shrubs. Charming front three-quarter game illustration, simple silhouettes readable small. This is the HIGH upgrade tier, visibly grander than humble cottages:
Row1: grand stepped gable town hall; cathedral with two towers and long stone nave; university with courtyard and three attached wings; large newspaper printing works with brick chimney and stacks of newspapers.
Row2: grand lumber mill with sawmill wheel and timber sheds; iron works industrial brick complex with two chimneys, forge and anvils; fortified arsenal with stone halls, cannon and muskets; imposing stone fortress with four thick bastions and arched gateway.
Row3: cigar factory with large tobacco drying wing and chimney; textile mill with three-story windows and loom visible; rum factory with large copper stills and brick industrial hall; fur factory with several drying racks and two-story production hall.
Row4: warehouse expansion, three connected storehouses filled with crates; large stables with two barns and horses; shipyard with a tall nearly finished sailing ship and crane; ornate customs house with flag and crate stacks.
Transparent background and ground around each individual building. No shared landscape. Keep empty gutters between all cells.
